{{Short description|Angola football league season}} {{Use dmy dates|date=September 2025}} {{Infobox football league season | logo = | pixels = 250 | competition = [[Girabola]] | season = 2025–26 | dates = {{nowrap|20 September 2025 – 25 May 2026}} | winners = [[Petro de Luanda]] | relegated = Guelson FC, Redonda FC and Luanda City | continentalcup1 = Petro de luanda {{nowrap|[[CAF Champions League]]}} | continentalcup1 qualifiers = | continentalcup2 = 1 de Agosto {{nowrap|[[CAF Confederation Cup]]}} | continentalcup2 qualifiers = | league topscorer = Dago Tshibamba (18 goals) | biggest home win = Primeiro de Agosto 6-0 Luanda City and Petro de Luanda 6-0 Luanda City | biggest away win = [[Sagrada Esperança]] 0-3 [[Petro de Luanda]] Redonda FC 2-5 [[Petro de Luanda]] | highest scoring = | longest wins = | longest unbeaten = | longest winless = | longest losses = | matches = 240 | total goals = 510 | prevseason = [[2024–25 Girabola|2024–25]] | nextseason = [[2026–27 Girabola|2026–27]] | updated = }} The '''2025–26 Girabola''' will be the 48th season of the [[Girabola]]. the top-tier [[association football|football]] league in [[Angola]]. The season started on 20 September 2025 and ended on 25 May 2026.{{cite web |date=31 August 2025 |title=Clubs exempt from arbitration fees|url=https://angop.ao/fr/noticias/desporto/clubes-isentos-de-pagamento-de-emolumentos-de-arbitragem-no-girabola/|access-date=2025-09-06|language=fr}}{{cite web|url=https://angop.ao/noticias/desporto/girabola2025-26-arranca-dia-20-de-setembro/|title=Girabola 2025–26 inicia-se no disrespect 20 de setembro|publisher=angop.ao|language=Pt}}{{cite web|url=https://angop.ao/noticias/desporto/estadio-sagrada-esperanca-apto-para-o-girabola2025-26/|title=estadio sagrada esperanca pronto para girabola 2025-26|publisher=angop.ao|language=Pt}} [[Atlético Petróleos de Luanda|Atlético Petróleos]] are the defending champions after winning the 2024–25 Girabola season, having won their fourth consecutive Girabola title, (19th title top-flight crown overall) in the previous season.{{cite web|access-date=2025-08-28 |date=2025-08-10 |first=Adão |language=pt-PT |last=Vicente |title=PETRO DE LUANDA VISITA CERCLE JOACHIM NA PRIMEIRA ELIMINATÓRIA DA LIGA DOS CAMPEÕES AFRICANA |url=https://petroatletico.co.ao/noticia/115248 |website=Sítio oficial do [[Atlético Petróleos de Luanda|Petro de Luanda]]}} ==Teams== The league consists of 16 teams – the top 13 teams from the previous season, and three teams promoted from the 2024–25 [[Angolan Provincial Football Stage|Provincial stages]] === Changes from previous season === [[Estrela Clube Primeiro de Maio|1º de Maio]], Redonda and Guelson were promoted from the [[Angolan Provincial Football Stage|Segundona]], replacing [[Santa Rita de Cássia FC|Santa Rita]], GD Escolinha Isaac do Benguela and Carmona. The championship began with a derby between Kabuscorp and Interclube, which Kabuscorp won with a goal by Sandro. Also in the first round, Bravos do Maquis thrashed (5-1) the newly promoted and historic Primeiro de Maio de Benguela, and we already had one game annulled (Petro de Luanda - Sagrada, which Petro later won 3-0). In the 4th round, we had the 90th classic between Petro and Primeiro de Agosto, which ended with a victory for the military team with a header from Mabilson in the 71st minute at the 11 de Novembro stadium. In the last round, São Salvador do Kongo and Luanda City faced each other, with the winner securing a spot among the elite in the next Girabola. In a highly competitive match, Filó scored and secured a place for the next season, while Luanda City was relegated back to the second division after two seasons. '''Promotions to the Girabola 2026-27''' On June 6th, after a 5-1 victory against Marítimo de Benguela, [[FC Cabinda]] returned to the national first division championship after [[2011 Girabola|15 years]], just as [[Recreativo da Caála]] had returned after 4 years. In play-off for the onde [[F.C. Luanda|FC Luanda]], by defeating Sporting de Luanda (1-0), achieved promotion, reaching the first division in a club with a history spanning 91 years. In the final, which too place at França Ndalu stadium, Recreativo da Caála and FC Cabinda drew in normal time (1-1), and which extra time, Recreativo da Caála was crowned champion of the Segundona (4-3) in the penalty shooutout. == Results == Each team plays each other twice (30 matches each), once at home and once away. {{#invoke:sports results|main | source = [https://www.livescore.com/en/football/angola/girabola/results/ liveScore], [https://www.sofascore.com/tournament/football/angola/girabola/2308#id:82114 Sofascore] | update =future|start_date =20 Sep 2025 | matches_style= FBR | solid_cell=grey |team_order=1DM, ACA, APL, BMQ, DHL, DLS, GUE, INT, KAB, LUA, PRI, RED, RLB, SAG, SSR, WIL |name_1DM=[[Estrela Clube Primeiro de Maio|1° de Maio]] |name_ACA=[[Académica Petróleos do Lobito|Académica do Lobito]] |name_APL=[[Atlético Petróleos de Luanda|Petro de Luanda]] |name_BMQ=[[F.C.
